issues.description: entity_filterable_keys table not in bpm_test tenant_default schema. Migration 1168 was recorded in public.schema_migrations for schema_name='public' (tenant_only no-op) but never applied to tenant_default. ORCH manually ran CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS in tenant_default (table now exists, but index is missing and schema_migrations ledger is NOT updated for schema_name='tenant_default').
appendDenyAudit in src/entity_query.zig uses catch {}; which swallows errors and leaks the 32-byte auditIdToHex buffer. 3 QRY-04 tests report 1 leak each.

task.description:
Fix two issues from TEST-RUNNER rework2 then run test-env-verify.

## Fix 1: Complete migration 1168 for bpm_test

1. Run: $env:BPM_DB_URL='postgres://bpm:bpm@localhost:5434/bpm_test'; zig build migrate
   This will call provisionTenantSchema -> runForSchema('tenant_default') which will:
   - Find 1168 pending for schema_name='tenant_default' (table already exists via IF NOT EXISTS, creates index, records ledger)
2. Verify: docker exec r-co-db_test-1 psql -U bpm -d bpm_test -c "SELECT schema_name, version FROM public.schema_migrations WHERE version='1168_qry_filterable_keys.sql';"
   Expected: rows for BOTH 'public' AND 'tenant_default'
3. Verify: docker exec r-co-db_test-1 psql -U bpm -d bpm_test -c "SELECT tablename FROM pg_tables WHERE tablename='entity_filterable_keys';"
   Expected: tenant_default row present

If zig build migrate fails or the tenant_default ledger row is still missing, apply manually:
   docker exec r-co-db_test-1 psql -U bpm -d bpm_test -c "SET search_path TO tenant_default,public; CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_efk_entity_key ON entity_filterable_keys (entity_key); INSERT INTO public.schema_migrations (schema_name, version) VALUES ('tenant_default', '1168_qry_filterable_keys.sql') ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING;"

## Fix 2: Memory leak in appendDenyAudit

In src/entity_query.zig, find the appendDenyAudit function (around line 430).
The function calls writeAuditInTx and uses 'catch {};' which swallows errors and leaks the 32-byte buffer allocated by auditIdToHex in audit.zig.

Fix: Replace 'catch {};' with proper error handling — either:
  (a) 'catch |err| { std.log.warn("appendDenyAudit: {}", .{err}); }' — log and continue (preferred: deny audit failure should NOT fail the response)
  (b) OR ensure the buffer is freed in the catch path

The fix must pass 'zig build' (exit 0) with no compile errors.

## Verification

1. zig build (exit 0)
2. zig build test-env-verify (exit 0, all checks PASS)
3. git add -A; git commit -m 'fix(QRY): apply migration 1168 to bpm_test + fix appendDenyAudit leak'

Return PASS only when both zig build and test-env-verify exit 0.
